script: Decision: excluded. The claimant reports surge damage confined to the laptop’s internal circuitry, as confirmed by a technician. CA-HO4-CURRENT expressly excludes damage to circuitry within computers from the electrical-current peril; no material information gap remains. Next action: Issue a denial citing the computer circuitry exception in CA-HO4-CURRENT.
